title: Russian DNA phantom experiments
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Russian DNA phantom experiments, about 1990s at Russia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In the 1990s, Russian scientists described something even more bizarre. In their so-called DNA phantom experiments

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that in the 1990s Russian scientists described something he calls even more bizarre than what came before, in what were known as the DNA phantom experiments. He does not say much more about what they found. He brings it up because, if true, it would suggest that DNA, the molecule that carries our genetic code, leaves behind some strange lasting trace or effect that ordinary science does not explain.
